svg.title: SATB2-dependent gene programs in CA1 sublayer identity and inhibitory circuitry
svg.desc: Neuroday research poster. Measured RNA changes in CA1 after postnatal Satb2 deletion, gene programs, candidate intercellular signals and proposed chromatin and physiology assays.

rect.data-label: Plum header background

g.text: CA1 sublayer identity and inhibitory circuitry
Mujahid Ali, Nico Wahl, Georg Dechant, Galina Apostolova
Institute for Neuroscience, Medical University of Innsbruck, Innsbruck, Austria

g.title: Presynaptic bouton contacting a dendritic spine
g.desc: A continuous dendritic shaft bears varied spines. A vesicle-containing bouton faces a postsynaptic density across the cleft at a mushroom spine.

g.text: Does SATB2 help build a memory circuit, maintain it, or both?
Our group showed that SATB2 helps active cortical neurons refold their DNA
and that losing it in the forebrain impairs long-term memory in mice.
In developing CA1, embryonic loss strengthens inhibition from parvalbumin
Our two lines shift complete loss from P15 to P30. Starting with P60 RNA,
we will test which DNA contacts and synapses depend on this timing.
P60 RNA measured · P15–P21 and P90 proposed
Cell identities in 107,747 nuclei from 12 mice

g.text: C6 subclusters appear in the tree.

g.title: Hippocampal nuclei, CA1 layer programs and inhibitory clusters
g.desc: Seurat classification across wild-type and Satb2 conditional knockout mice. A common stem branches into five major cell types. The excitatory branch expands into CA1 and prosubiculum cluster markers and their layer assignments. The inhibitory branch shows all original clusters with C6 divided into three SST subclusters. Each terminal cluster has its own color. Superficial and deep layer markers are ranked by paired wild-type expression. Branch widths are schematic. Hover over a marker or ribbon to read the original cluster identifier.

text.data-label: Seurat · Inhibitory labels reflect expression profiles. Ribbon widths are schematic.

g.text: Seurat · Inhibitory labels reflect expression profiles. Ribbon widths are schematic.
Dot area shows the fraction of nuclei expressing each gene. Shading spans zero to the highest group mean for that marker in each view.
SATB2 loss alters 2.39× as many genes in superficial as in deep CA1
Higher in all 6 WT mice · median ratio 1.60×.
1,201 reached FDR in superficial CA1 alone, 168 in deep alone.
573 of 574 shared genes changed in the same direction.
One dot per gene. The diagonal marks equal changes.
143 of 258 retained FDR < 0.05 in a subset of 6 WT and 3 cKO mice.
Synaptic and adhesion genes nominate CA1–interneuron signals

g.title: Selected Gene Ontology biological processes
g.desc: Fold enrichment relative to tested, annotated genes. Counts are annotated hits over eligible genes in each list. Q values are Benjamini–Hochberg adjusted within each list. Selected terms may share genes.
g.text: ¹ Via plasma-membrane adhesion molecules. 1× = expected representation.
Full cohort, 6 WT / 6 cKO. Subset, 6 WT / 3 cKO. Dash = no fit.
All six gene-level changes pass FDR < 0.05 in the full cohort.
Arrows indicate candidate signaling. SST C6 includes several subtypes.
Responses may be indirect. Test candidate pathways with targeted perturbation.
From a change in Ptn RNA to a test of CA1 circuit function

text.tspan: RNA fell 52% in superficial and 36% in deep CA1.

g.text: Do SATB2 binding, chromatin state and

g.title: CA1 sampling branches into nuclear profiling and acute-slice physiology
g.desc: The RNA route comes from the measured P60 cohort. Dashed paths are proposed. The small RNA embedding uses observed coordinates. Other assay readouts are schematic.

g.title: Mouse coronal section and enlarged dorsal hippocampus
g.desc: Atlas-based schematic. Dorsal is up and lateral is right. CA1 is highlighted in teal and the dentate granule cell layer is blue-grey. Adapted from the Allen Mouse Brain Atlas, adult coronal image 100960240. Anatomical reference © Allen Institute for Brain Science.

g.title: Optional fluorescence-activated nuclei sorting
g.desc: The laser interrogates the sample stream before droplet breakoff. The illustrative scatter plot shows some events inside a selection gate.

g.text: P60 · 6 wild-type and 6 early conditional knockout mice

g.title: Reciprocal paired recordings in an acute hippocampal slice
g.desc: Two glass pipettes each contact a soma. Stimulation of a CA1 pyramidal cell can evoke an excitatory current in its interneuron partner. Stimulation of the interneuron can evoke an inhibitory current in the pyramidal cell.

g.text: Test excitation from superficial or deep pyramidal cells
to PV or SST interneurons, and inhibition in return.

text.tspan: Test which RNA and circuit changes recur with one functional
allele and which recover after P50–P60 re-expression.

g.text: Comparing early and late loss will help distinguish developmental timing from adult maintenance.
